description: Cross-language pin of the PlatePredictions artefact and completion-body worst-case size bound (ADR-013 implementation amendment 2026-10-13, item 13; owner decision 2026-10-13). The bounded v1 processing profile allows at most 2 detector proposals and 1 accepted plate per evidence crop and at most 3 candidate readings for it; output beyond a configured bound is a contract violation, never truncated. Both the .NET release parser and the Python loader compute exactly these numbers from a profile's shape (maxDetectionsPerCrop, maxPlatesPerCrop, maxReadingsPerPlate) at 10,000 Tracks x 4 crops; every profile inside the v1 limits fits maximumBytes (the 64 MiB cap), and the largest, bounded-v1-profile, is the worst case.
